title: LatchGitWorktreeSummariesV2
description: GET /v2/git/worktree/summaries?worktreeRefs= takes one to eight comma-separated worktree references. The response has one result per input in order, including duplicates. Repeated references share one outcome within a request. Empty or oversized batches return 400. An active paired device with Control is required for all results. A stale, foreign, or unknown reference produces stale_worktree_ref. A malformed individual reference produces invalid_request.

branch.description: Current branch, or null for detached HEAD.

ahead.description: Commits ahead of the locally known upstream, or null if Git cannot determine the count.

behind.description: Commits behind the locally known upstream, or null if Git cannot determine the count.

untracked.description: Git's normal untracked entries, which may represent directories.

changesComplete.description: False when the status scan reached its record or byte limit or encountered an unfamiliar record. Counts are then lower bounds. A tracked path can count in both staged and unstaged.
